description: Retail Media Delivery API GET requests on d.us.criteo.com and d.eu.criteo.com /delivery/retailmedia. The OneTag loader on dynamic.criteo.com stays vendor/criteo.

params.name: criteo-partner-id
params.description: It is the Criteo partner ID. Criteo documents it as required on every Delivery API request.
params.fix_hint: Set `criteo-partner-id` to the numeric partner ID from your Criteo technical account manager.

params.name: retailer-visitor-id
params.description: It is a persistent unauthenticated user ID on the same device. Criteo documents it as required on every Delivery API request.
params.fix_hint: Set `retailer-visitor-id` to a first-party ID that lasts at least 30 days.

params.name: page-id
params.description: It is the page ID Criteo issued for the placement. Criteo documents it as required on every Delivery API request.
params.fix_hint: Set `page-id` to the value from your Criteo team, such as `viewHome_API_desktop`.

params.name: event-type
params.description: It is the page or organic event type. Criteo documents it as required on each page-type request, such as `viewHome`, `addToCart`, or `trackTransaction`.
params.fix_hint: Set `event-type` to the documented value for the page, such as `viewHome`.

params.name: customer-id
params.description: It is the authenticated user ID. Criteo documents it as required when the user is logged in, and empty when they are not.
params.fix_hint: Set `customer-id` to the logged-in CRM id, or leave it empty for a guest.

params.name: email
params.description: It is the user's email as a SHA-256 hex digest. Criteo documents trimming, cleaning, and lowercasing before hashing.
params.fix_hint: Send a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the cleaned email.

params.name: page-uid
params.description: It links an organic add-to-cart to the page-load ad request. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart`.
params.fix_hint: Set `page-uid` to the value returned on the initial Delivery API call for that page.

params.name: item
params.description: It is the SKU, or a pipe-separated SKU list. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart` and `trackTransaction`.
params.fix_hint: Set `item` to the SKU, or to pipe-separated SKUs such as `123|456|789`.

params.name: price
params.description: It is the unit price, or a pipe-separated list aligned with `item`. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart` and `trackTransaction`.
params.fix_hint: Send unit prices as numbers, pipe-separated when there is more than one SKU, such as `29.99|15.49`.

params.name: quantity
params.description: It is the quantity, or a pipe-separated list aligned with `item`. Criteo documents it as required on `addToCart` and `trackTransaction`. Cancellations use `0`.
params.fix_hint: Send integer quantities, pipe-separated when there is more than one SKU.

params.name: transaction-id
params.description: It is the unique order ID. Criteo documents it as required on `trackTransaction`.
params.fix_hint: Set `transaction-id` to the order ID, and reuse it for cancellations and modifications.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of the order. Criteo documents it as required only when the retailer sells in more than one currency.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD` or `EUR`.

params.name: nocall
params.description: It filters sponsored products, commerce display, or both from the Delivery API response.

params.name: verbosity
params.description: It is the product-object verbosity in the Delivery API response. Criteo documents `min` and `full`.

params.name: device-id
params.description: It is the GAID or IDFA for in-app traffic. Criteo documents it when Offsite is activated.
params.fix_hint: Send the advertising ID for the device.

params.name: device-id-type
params.description: It names the identifier in `device-id`. Criteo documents `gaid` or `idfa`.

rules.message: An `addToCart` event is missing `page-uid`, `item`, `price`, or `quantity`. Criteo documents all four on organic add-to-cart.
rules.fix_hint: Send `page-uid` from the page-load response plus `item`, unit `price`, and `quantity`.

rules.message: A `trackTransaction` event is missing `item`, `price`, `quantity`, or `transaction-id`. Criteo documents all four on order confirmation.
rules.fix_hint: Send pipe-separated `item`, unit `price`, and `quantity` lists plus `transaction-id`.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Criteo documents `retailer-visitor-id`, `customer-id`, and `device-id` as unhashed. Hash email instead.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw visitor, customer, or device ID. Hash only `email`.
